source_rollout: Actual per-fold/seed T0_AMP_R1 own causal P0/P1 decisions; no oracle positive bank
mixed_assignment: Sort all frozen episode_uids lexicographically; even index P0, odd index P1, for fit and inner
full_inner_state_reconstruction: Reconstruct before-state on EVERY frame from sealed preceding selected UID/write event and sole initial click; exact equality against all saved stride-five snapshots is mandatory
initialization: Strict load the same outer/seed T0_AMP_R1 inner-selected checkpoint for all three conditions
loss: Same T0 candidate/NONE NLL + 0.5 availability CE + 0.2 verified current write correctness BCE
invalid_update: Skip and retry identical minibatch at reduced scale; after five overflows FP32 same-batch fallback; never apply nonfinite gradients
checkpoint_selection: Own condition INNER full-frame loss only; no outer outcome selection
updated_T1_model_self_rollout_refresh_an: T2, not silently claimed complete by T1
outer_shared_initialization_metadata: Only initialization manifest is parsed; outer future GT, query features and pixels are not used for fit/inner loss
